verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's own page states that DDoS protection, WAF, bot management and Zero Trust controls are built into the network and "run on every request from day one," which directly matches the story's by-default, every-request requirement. That support rests on one marketing-level claim only. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on what the default WAF rules cover and which plans include them, specifics of DDoS mitigation for Workers routes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
